box.UV: finite in four dimensions after tensor reduction of four cubic vertices
box.numerator: product of four cubic Feynman-rule tensors at the existing vertices; group and Lorentz/spinor indices from those vertices

bubble.UV: pole of one over sixteen pi squared eps, P5G Z_G
bubble.numerator: two cubic (or seagull) tensors; P5H2 already cut this topology

counterterm.UV: cancels the 1PI triangle+bubble pole on the declared operator basis
counterterm.coupling: delta_Z_G * g^2 symbolic; g not fitted
counterterm.measure: local in four dimensions; no loop integral
counterterm.numerator: tree AAAA/AAA or covariant-kinetic vertex times delta_Z from P5G

crossed_box.numerator: same cubic tensors as the box with crossed momentum routing

provenance: DERIVED GIVEN EXISTING FEYNMAN RULES + P5G REGULATOR

triangle.UV: pole of one over sixteen pi squared eps, reduced to declared Z_G / wave-function CTs
triangle.coupling: g^3 or g^2 symbolic according to the quartic
triangle.numerator: two cubic tensors times one quartic (AAAA or phi_phi_AA) from the existing action
